Section 1 covers Source or Object works based on the licensed Work whose modifications, considered together, constitute original authorship. It excludes works that remain separable or merely link or bind by name to interfaces of the Work or its derivatives.
Sections 4(a) through 4(c) impose separate conditions. ASF release-packaging policies fall outside this assessment.
reasoning: Section 4(d) supports revision 2 of apache-20-section-4d-notice-attributions. When the upstream distribution includes a NOTICE text file, a distributor of Derivative Works must supply a readable copy of each attribution in that file that pertains to any part of the derivative. At least one permitted location suffices. The distributor may use a NOTICE text file included in the derivative distribution, Source or documentation supplied with the derivative, or a display the derivative itself generates, if and wherever third-party notices of that kind ordinarily appear.
